notes: Compact self-powered wide-coverage point-source loudspeaker in Meyer Sound's IntelligentDC series (sealed extruded-aluminum enclosure, 103 x 103 x 145 mm, 1.9 kg). It has exactly ONE physical connector on the rear panel — a Switchcraft EN3 5-pin male — confirmed as the sole connection point by the datasheet, operating instructions, and architectural specification (all docs.meyersound.com). That connector combines two functions on one shell: 48V DC IntelligentDC power (pins 1-2) and differential balanced analog audio input (pins 3-5, 10kΩ input impedance); applying DC to the audio pins or vice versa damages the unit. There is no separate power inlet, no audio output/loop-through, and no network/RJ45/control port on this model. The speaker requires an external Meyer Sound power supply (MPS-482HP or MPS-488HP, sold separately) — it has no standalone AC mains inlet. No connector id in the provided list matches Switchcraft EN3 exactly; xlr5 (5-pin XLR-style) was chosen as the closest analog since both are 5-pin locking audio-style connectors, though EN3 is a distinct, non-XLR-compatible Switchcraft series. No bandwidth grade applies (analog audio + DC combo connector, not in any graded category) so grade was omitted per instructions. Exact rear-panel silkscreen label text for the connector was not stated in any fetched document, so "Audio/DC In" is a descriptive name rather than a confirmed printed label. Not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted) — it mounts via two 3/8"-16 side inserts or an optional U-bracket. A related dual-15° model (MM-4XPD) exists with its own separate datasheet/spec sheet.

ports.name: Audio/DC In
ports.note: Actual connector is a Switchcraft EN3 5-pin male (not true XLR5) carrying both balanced analog audio input (pins 3-5) and 48V DC IntelligentDC power input (pins 1-2) from an external Meyer Sound power supply, on a single rear-panel jack. xlr5 is the closest listed connector id.
